title: FHA-insured mortgage - basics
facts: FHA does not generally lend money directly to homebuyers; approved lenders make loans that FHA insures.
FHA-insured mortgages can allow lower down payments and more flexible underwriting than some conventional loans, subject to lender and FHA requirements.
Borrowers pay FHA mortgage insurance under applicable program rules.
FHA eligibility, loan limits, property standards and underwriting requirements must be checked for the current program and location.
